producer_report.summary: Built job 1 of the job-planning design with no change in behavior. It adds the athena.job-plan/1 and athena.critique/1 records with validation (round 0 refused, an accepting critique with a blocker or major finding refused), Role::Planner, Role::Critic and FindingSource::Critic. Config gains an optional [job_plan] section (enabled false by default, bounds validated, skipped when absent, reset in reading_inputs); a test pins the pre-change reading digest, and adding an enabled section leaves it unchanged. The store gains job_of arms and loads plans and critiques per job, and a dispatched job with a plan but no outcome stays dispatched. The fake driver gains a planner covering every criterion and an accepting critic, the exhaustive role matches gain arms, and a lifecycle test shows go still runs only reader, producer and verifier. Docs, the changelog (with the departures from the design) and the design status line are updated. athena.toml and defaults.toml are untouched. cargo clippy and cargo fmt are clean; cargo test --locked returned without error."

checks_run.note: Command returned without an error; the output was too large to display and the saved copy could not be read, so pass counts were not read. This includes the new records, config, store, fake and lifecycle tests, and the xtask boundary test, which is in the workspace.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: all tests pass, and a fake-driver `go` still invokes only reader, producer and verifier roles.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test --locked returned without error (pass counts not read). New lifecycle test a_fake_driver_go_runs_only_the_reader_producer_and_verifier asserts the role set equals exactly {Reader, Producer, Verifier} and the job landed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: round-2 job-plan and critique records pass check_record_file at job-plan-2.json / critique-2.json and are refused as misplaced at round-1 paths; a round-0 record and an accepting critique holding a blocker or major finding are refused by parse.

Run `cargo test`: reading_inputs() for the repo's athena.toml matches a sha256 digest recorded in the test (computed from the pre-change code); adding [job_plan] enabled = true leaves it unchanged; max_rounds = 0, a zero cap, and an unknown key are each refused with a message naming the field.
criteria_check.evidence: config.rs tests reading_inputs_digest_is_unchanged_by_the_job_plan_section (digest ba462c7f... obtained by running the old code via a temporary test before any edit) and bad_job_plan_settings_are_refused_naming_the_field, which asserts the error text contains the field name.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: Records::load files committed plans and critiques under their job, and a dispatched job with a plan but no outcome stays dispatched.
criteria_check.evidence: store.rs test plans_and_critiques_are_filed_under_their_job_and_do_not_close_it commits a job record, plans and critiques to a temp git repo, loads them with Records::load, checks round order, no invalid files, outcome None and state Dispatched.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: clean; xtask's boundary test passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check, both clean. The xtask test is part of the workspace cargo test --locked, which returned without error; I did not run it on its own.

criteria_check.criterion: records.rs defines athena.job-plan/1, athena.critique/1, Role::Planner, Role::Critic, FindingSource::Critic with design sections 3-5 fields; config.rs has Config.job_plan: Option<JobPlanConfig> (deny_unknown_fields, skip_serializing_if none, enabled default false) reset to None in reading_inputs; store.rs job_of handles new records; all exhaustive matches (fake.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, tests/retry.rs, tests/common/mod.rs) cover the new roles, with a fake planner covering every brief criterion and an accepting critic.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the edited files. fake.rs test the_fake_planner_covers_every_criterion_and_the_critic_accepts passes criteria 1,2,3 through and checks the critic verdict is accept.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/records.md documents both records so an outside reader can see paths, fields and validity rules; CHANGELOG.md has an entry that notes any place the code disagreed with the design (findings F10, F15, F16 addressed).
criteria_check.evidence: Added layout lines and two table rows to docs/records.md listing paths, fields and validity rules; CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added entry names F10, F15, F16 and the departures from the design.
Neither file was edited; the config tests use the existing athena.toml via include_str and append a [job_plan] section in memory.

open_issues: The planner and critic output schemas do not exist until job 2, so the fake planner's and critic's JSON shapes are a guess at them.
run_pin_tests.rs uses unreachable! for the planner and critic arms, since planning is not wired in.
I did not read the cargo test pass counts, because the long output could not be displayed or opened.
mistakes: Tried to append to store.rs with a heredoc, which the policy refused; I used an editor edit instead.
A changelog edit failed first because its anchor matched 13 places; I redid it with a unique anchor.
learnings: Records::load sends any record whose job_of arm exists to JobRecords::add, and job_of panics via expect on an unknown type, so a new job-scoped record needs both arms.
reading_inputs already resets parallel and landing before serializing; job_plan follows the same pattern.
The pre-change digest of reading_inputs() for the repository's athena.toml is ba462c7ffba3475385f095363becb853b0eda55fed87c41e3f78d800cf1f63fc.
lifecycle.rs integration tests are the place for fake-driver go role assertions, using Scenario.invocations.
The producer Bash tool refuses pipes, heredocs and tail.
desires: A way to read long cargo test output within the working directory, to confirm the pass counts.
